Chicago, IL · Florists

Flowers for Dreams

$500–$25,000

Chicago wedding florist with full-service design consultants and a self-service option for smaller budgets. The company says it donates 25% of flower profits to charity.

The Chicago page says weddings range from $500 for simple personal flowers to $25,000 for full-service floristry and decor, and that the average Chicago-area couple spends about $4,000 to $5,000. Self-service is described as best under $3,000. · Source · checked 2026-10-03 · published

1812 West Hubbard St, Chicago, IL 60622
